summary: The Outer Planes are divine realms shaped by gods, ideals, and metaphysical forces. They reflect the moral, emotional, and conceptual foundations of existence.

events: Outer Planes formed around the Elemental core.
Gods claimed dominion over conceptual realms.
Planar boundaries stabilized into the Great Wheel.
First mortal souls began passing through the Outer Planes.
Planar breaches allowed mortals to invade divine realms.
Torment and Innovation destabilized due to divine conflict.
